title: The Boys in the Baths
edition: First edition; separate cover titled 'The Baths by Ryan McGinley'; edition of 1,000 copies

description.main: A separately covered edition of New York magazine's first men's style issue (September 28, 2026), built around Ryan McGinley's portraits of men at the Russian & Turkish Baths on East 10th Street.
description.extended:
A separately covered edition of New York magazine's first men's style issue, built around Ryan McGinley's portraits of men at the Russian & Turkish Baths on East 10th Street.

The issue came out on September 28, 2026. Senior men's style editor Samuel Hine and McGinley brought actors, writers and artists to the East Village bathhouse, and Miyako Bellizzi, the costume designer on Marty Supreme, styled the shoot with very little clothing. Troye Sivan, Elliot Page, Marlon James, and Mike Faist with Christopher Abbott appear on the four newsstand covers. The portfolio inside also includes Sam Nivola, Jeremy O. Harris, Eddie Huang, Rashid Johnson, Justin Peck and Francesco Clemente. This copy has its own cover, a close-up of a wet chest under the title The Baths by Ryan McGinley, and was issued in an edition of 1,000 copies. The rest of the issue carries reporting on the Chrome Hearts resale market and on Leo Dell'Orco, Giorgio Armani's longtime business partner.

The library holds four earlier McGinley books: Life Adjustment Center (Dashwood Books, 2010), The Journey Is the Destination (Purple, 2013), Way Far (Rizzoli, 2015) and the kids were alright (MCA Denver, 2017). Dashwood Books, which published the first of those, also offered this edition.

notes: Special-cover copy of New York magazine's Men's Style issue (Sept 28, 2026), 89 pages per Complex and Queerland. Dashwood Books item 31595 lists it as 'The Boys in the Baths', softcover, first edition; the cover reads 'The Baths by Ryan McGinley' and differs from the four newsstand covers. Edition of 1,000 copies per the library's owner; no source found states it. Portfolio length conflicts: 26 pages (Tom + Lorenzo) vs 20 pages with 19 subjects (Complex, citing Business of Fashion). No ISBN (periodical). Dimensions not found. PressReader article (pressreader.com/usa/new-york-magazine/20260928/281496463205141) returned 403. Cover is Dashwood's photo, cropped.
